author: SickProdigy
description: Prepare and orchestrate Base Sepolia Clanker token launches with interactive drafts, optional vaults and airdrops, and explicit wallet execution boundaries.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild launch configuration and bounded token launch audit records, including the requester identity until Red requests its deletion. Requester identity is then anonymized. It does not store private keys, seed phrases, API tokens, or wallet credentials.
install_msg: Configure `[p]clankerset treasury`, `[p]clankerset enabled true`, and any desired channel, role, cooldown, daily-limit, reward-split, vault, or airdrop settings. Use `[p]clank <symbol> [token name]` to start a Base Sepolia draft; `clank` is separate from the `clanker` management group. Verify the Discord card and launch with CryptoWallet; the obsolete generic REST path remains removed.
name: Clanker
short: Base Sepolia launches, token rundowns, rewards, and owner controls
